title: RetroArch 1.22.1: official stable release
summary: RetroArch published 1.22.1 on November 15, 2025. The release record documents an official stable release for the multi-system emulator project.

blocks.text: The RetroArch project published version 1.22.1 on November 15, 2025. GitHub marks this entry as a release; this distinction is preserved here so the build is not mistaken for a different update channel.

The GitHub record does not include an inline changelog, but it identifies version 1.22.1 and publishes these release files: retroarch-sourceonly-1.22.1.tar.xz (13561124 bytes). The version, date, and package record are retained in this article.
